caption: Air charge sets a base pulse from the calibration map (look-up table, not the MAP sensor); the injector fires, the exhaust sensor reads lambda, and the correction returns to the base pulse.

spec.title: Closed-loop fuel control
spec.aria: Air charge sets a base pulse from the calibration map, the injector fires for 8.94 ms, the oxygen sensor measures lambda, and the fuel trim feeds a correction back into the base pulse.
